mapper.select: SELECT od.orders_detail_id AS orderDetailId, o.order_date AS orderDate, b.brand_name AS brandName, od.product_name AS productName, od.option_name AS optionName, od.quantity, od.price, od.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus FROM ORDERS_DETAIL od JOIN ORDERS o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN BRAND b ON od.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE od.delivery_status IN (5, 12) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
